look: Manticore, a B-rank GKOM variant from the Spinetail Chimeras family: lion-bodied manticore with a grinning face, bat wings and a tail full of crystal spines. Family anatomy: chimera beasts: lynx and lion bodies with scorpion-like crystal-spined tails. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: half the body armoured in GKOM crystal, natural patches between the plates; the crystals are blood-orange spine crystal. A softball-sized GKOM core orb, dark crimson with a steady pulse, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Fire: ember red, orange and gold accents, strong embers, flame ribbons and heat shimmer
